name: Hanazono Karin
source:
Karin is the childhood friend of [url=https://vndb.org/c21956]Atsu[/url], [url=https://vndb.org/c77257]Jun[/url], [url=https://vndb.org/c21957]Yume[/url], [url=https://vndb.org/c21958]Yurari[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c77251]Seiji[/url].

She has always been very close to Seiji, her best friend, and she never cried so much as the day he left 10 years ago. When the Kanou family moved back to town, Karin is the verry first to visit them, disguised as a superhero like when she played with Seiji when they were young.

She has a rather Deredere character and despite the fact that she is grown up and has become very attractive, she keeps some old tomboy habits. Very friendly, she makes friends very easily and quickly. It is thanks to all her qualities and her common passion for cats that she was able to become friends with [url=https://vndb.org/c21959]Mitsu[/url], a very pretty German student who has recently joined the school.

She doesn't trust at all in her feminine charms and she quickly loses her feet when Seiji compliments her.

[spoiler]When she was little, she played daddy and mommy with Seiji in their secret base and even made a plaque with their names on, as if they had been married. During the 10 years of his absence, she went there frequently to remind herself of those moments that she considers extremely precious.

She doesn't know why A-chan started to get away from her and Jin but she would like to get close to her again because she loves her a lot.

Karin is quite popular with other students in reality, some even suggest to her to show her feminine charms to Seiji so that he falls in love with her and they would finally go out together.

She has a diary she has been holding for years and where she has written a lot of embarrassing things inside, especially about her feelings for Seiji.[/spoiler]
